exercise1.prompt: Three ways to say a condition that reads like the question.

hiddenCases.name: an empty list of subjects matches nothing
isin does the testing
hiddenCases.describe: isin rather than a chain of comparisons

exercise1.hint: df["subject"].isin(subjects) is the mask. Its sum is the count, and int() makes it a plain number.

choices: A collection of values to test against
questions.explain: It replaces a chain of == joined with |, and reads as the sentence you were trying to write.

questions.prompt: Is between inclusive of its endpoints?
questions.explain: Both ends are included unless you say otherwise, which matches how a range usually reads in a question.

questions.prompt: Why does an empty list passed to isin match nothing?
choices: No value is in an empty set
questions.explain: The condition is "is this value one of these", and there are none, so it is False everywhere. Worth knowing before you build the list from a filter that came back empty.
